newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fator starts Brazil paper firms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fator starts Brazil paper firms.

text.p: -- Local investment bank Banco Fator SA said in a report it has begun coverage of Brazilian pulp-paper firms Aracruz and Klabin with buy recommendations.
-- The bank also said it started coverage of local pulp and paper producers Bahia Sul and Ripasa as holds and Suzano with a sell recommendation.
-- Fator also said it was reiterating its buy recommendation on pulp-paper firm Votorantim Celulose e Papel (VCP).
-- VCP and Klabin are undervalued based on 1997 and 1998 estimates for earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA), the report said.

-- They are expected to generate free cash flow, despite large investments in new production units aimed at improving production after 1998, and "both plan to internationalize their capital in 1997," it said.
-- Fator said Aracruz also is "well-valued" and expects the stock's price to rise along with company operating expansions.
-- Meanwhile, "debt servicing at Bahia Sul and Ripasa should continue consuming operating income over the next two years," which is already reflected in their prices, the bank said.
-- Investments by Suzano, Brazil's second-largest pulp and paper manufacturer, in unrelated sectors "should deplete cash generation," Fator said.
